title: OGC API Processes: submit geometry.buffer asynchronously, poll, read the result
promise: A customer runs a server-side buffer as an asynchronous job through the SDK's processes client and reads a result whose ring and centroid follow from the input.

steps.description: Submit geometry.buffer for the fixture point asynchronously; a job id is returned.
Poll the job until it is terminal; it succeeds.
Read the job result; every ring vertex lies at the fixture distance from the fixture point and the centroid is the point.
